title: Legal Research and Writing I
audience: a law student in a U.S. JD program
purpose: Find and read primary and secondary authority, brief cases, synthesize rules, write objective office memos in IRAC or CREAC form, cite authority with standard legal citation, and write professional emails and client letters.

weeks.1: The U.S. legal system and the sources of law
weeks.7: The office memo: structure and IRAC or CREAC
weeks.12: Professional responsibility in research and writing

blocks.deliverable: Brief three cases in a standard format.
Write a research plan and log for a supplied question.
Synthesize a rule from four supplied cases.
Week 7 midterm; write a memo discussion section on a single issue.
Correct the citations and wording of a supplied draft.
Write a client letter explaining a memo's conclusion in plain English.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Closed-universe memo: using the facts and cases supplied in the project, write a 2,500-word objective office memo with a question presented, brief answer, facts, discussion and conclusion.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
